units.source_text: 当天上午，马上把住处改在奈良屋旅馆。

en.t: That morning, they immediately moved their lodging to the Naraya Inn.

units.source_text: 翌日，即十一日，在奈良屋一号别馆里继续弈战，已经时隔十二三天了。

en.t: The next day, the eleventh, play continued in Naraya Annex Number One, after an interval of already twelve or thirteen days.

units.source_text: 从这天起，名人进入棋境，

en.t: From that day on, the Master entered the realm of the game,

units.source_text: 再也不提任性的要求，老实至极，恍如已委身于别人。

en.t: and he no longer made willful demands; he was utterly docile, as though he had entrusted himself to someone else.
